english.meaning: baking soda; also soda in general, a loanword
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: So if I were boxing Tyson, I’d marinate him in baking soda first—it’d make things much easier.
exampleSentences.traditional: 所以如果同泰臣。我成日覺得打拳之前呢，揾啲梳打醃下佢呢。就容易打好多。
